name: Comparison sorting
description: Given n keys from a totally ordered universe, output all input keys in nondecreasing order, preserving multiplicities. The algorithm must be correct for every ordering and for inputs containing equal keys.

name: Static predecessor
description: Given a static set S of n keys from the universe {0, …, 2^w - 1}, preprocess S so that a query key x returns the largest y in S with y ≤ x, or reports that no such key exists. Account separately for preprocessing time, space, and query time.

name: Single-source shortest paths
description: Given a directed graph G = (V, E) with n vertices, m edges, nonnegative edge weights, and a source vertex s, compute the exact distance from s to every vertex, reporting infinity for unreachable vertices. State how edge weights are represented.

name: Fully dynamic connectivity
description: Maintain an undirected graph on a fixed set of n vertices under an online sequence of edge insertions and deletions. A connectivity query for vertices u and v must report whether they are in the same connected component. Distinguish worst-case from amortized and deterministic from randomized guarantees.

name: Maximum s-t flow
description: Given a directed graph G = (V, E), nonnegative integral edge capacities, a source s, and a sink t, compute the value and an explicit representation of a maximum feasible s-t flow. State the capacity encoding and whether arithmetic cost depends on capacity size.
